typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Changethistable_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Unumber as string,
		FullName as string,
		Category as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromFile1
fromFile1 derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		UNumber as string,
		Category as string,
		FullName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		UNumber = Unumber,
		Category,
		FullName),
	partitionFileNames:[($Changethistable_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Changethistable
